title: Structured Maps for Landmark-Based Route Instructions with LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.36582v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: To generate landmark-based route instructions, models must understand both map geometry and human landmark preferences. Although large language models (LLMs) show great abilities in language tasks, the best way to structure map data for these models is not yet established. This paper proposes a structured text representation for landmark selection tasks in route navigation, utilizing SVG format to encode spatial features. The structured text maintains a geometric connection with rendered map images, allowing language models to directly access spatial and semantic data. Using a new dataset created from human-written route descriptions and OpenStreetMap data, we evaluate models on two tasks: landmark selection at turns and around destinations. translated_title: 面向大语言模型基于地标的路线指令的结构化地图
translated_abstract: 为了生成基于地标的路线指令，模型必须同时理解地图几何结构和人类对地标的偏好。尽管大语言模型在语言任务中展现出强大的能力，但为这些模型构建地图数据的最佳方式尚未确立。本文提出了一种用于路线导航中地标选择任务的结构化文本表示方法，利用SVG格式来编码空间特征。这种结构化文本与渲染的地图图像保持几何关联，使语言模型能够直接访问空间和语义数据。基于从人类撰写的路线描述和OpenStreetMap数据创建的新数据集，我们在两个任务上评估了模型：转弯处的地标选择和目的地周围的地标选择。对五个大语言模型的实验表明，所提出的结构化文本输入的表现与基于图像的PNG输入相当甚至更好。此外，任务特定的微调使较小的本地大语言模型能够（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出用SVG格式将地图数据结构化为文本表示，使大语言模型在路线导航的地标选择任务中表现与图像输入相当或更优，并证明了小型本地模型经微调后也可胜任该任务。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an SVG-based structured text representation of map data that enables LLMs to match or exceed image-based inputs on landmark selection tasks for route instructions, with fine-tuned smaller local models also proving capable.
